To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the combination of interest propagation and content enrichment is the most effective approach for personalized link recommendations, (2) the combination of temporal dynamics and content enrichment is also effective, (3) interest propagation is more effective than temporal dynamics, (4) content enrichment is more effective than interest representation and (5) the combination of all four user modeling dimensions is not necessarily the best.

(1) the combination of interest representation and interest propagation strategies outperform individual strategies and (2) the combination of all four user modeling dimensions outperform the combination of the first two dimensions.

(1) user modeling on the Social Web is an important and fundamental step for personalized link recommendation, (2) the combination of interest representation, interest propagation, content enrichment and temporal dynamics of user modeling is a promising approach for user modeling on the social Web and (3) the combination of these strategies can improve the quality of user modelling significantly.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following three research questions: (1) How to effectively and efficiently represent user interests in the Social Web? (2) How to model the temporal dynamics of user interest evolution on the Social Web? and (3) How to propagate user interest in the Social Web for personalized link recommendations?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best performing strategy is to combine all four dimensions of user modeling.
the combination of the four dimensions is the most effective strategy to model user interest and thus to provide better recommendations.
a combination of the two user modeling strategies interest propagation and interest representation is the best performing user model for personalized link recommendation on the Social Web.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new user modeling strategy for personalized link recommendations.
we have investigated different user modeling strategies in four dimensions, i.e. interest representation, interest propagation, content enrichment and temporal dynamics of user interest.
the combination of all the four dimensions is the best strategy for user modeling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of personalized link recommendations is highly dependent on user modeling strategies.
a combination of different user modeling strategies is more effective and robust than using a single strategy alone.
a comprehensive user modeling strategy that combines the four dimensions is more effective than the individual ones.
